records.source_title: Gühring – From drill pioneer to complete supplier (company history)
records.excerpt: Gühring is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of precision rotary tools for metal machining. With over 7,000 employees worldwide, including more than 3,500 in Germany, the company develops, manufactures and distributes innovative cutting tools at over 70 production sites in 48 countries.
records.population: Gühring group
records.does_not_establish: Headcount and site counts say nothing about revenue, margins or whether any sales go to private buyers.

records.source_title: Gühring – From drill pioneer to complete supplier (company history)
records.excerpt: Gühring is present in all major markets: customers from the automotive industry, aerospace, and mechanical engineering rely on its leading-edge tool, which is manufactured worldwide to the highest quality standards.
records.population: Gühring's industrial customers
records.does_not_establish: It names industries served but gives no share of sales by customer group and does not rule out sales to individuals.

records.source_title: Gühring – From drill pioneer to complete supplier (company history)
records.excerpt: Founded as a hardware store, four generations of the Gühring family have led the company from Albstadt into the globalised world of machining.
records.population: Gühring company history
records.does_not_establish: A hardware-store origin in 1898 does not show any current retail capability or consumer brand recognition.

records.source_title: Gühring Nachhaltigkeitsbericht 2024 (CSR-Bericht)
records.excerpt: Mit 2.287 Mitarbeitenden entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt Gühring innovative Zerspanungswerkzeuge und ist in allen bedeutenden Märkten sowie Schlüsselbranchen vertreten. Kunden aus der Automobilindustrie, der Luft- und Raumfahrt, dem Maschinenbau, sowie der Medizintechnik setzen auf die technologisch führenden Werkzeuge, die weltweit nach einheitlichen Qualitätsstandards auf höchstem Niveau gefertigt werden.
records.population: Gühring KG, the German parent company
records.does_not_establish: The 2,287 headcount covers the reporting entity, not the 7,000-person group, and the report gives no revenue figure.

records.source_title: Gühring Nachhaltigkeitsbericht 2024 (CSR-Bericht)
records.excerpt: Durch ein engmaschig gewebtes Netz an kaufmännischen sowie technischen Außendienstmitarbeitenden und Standorten garantiert Gühring eine erstklassige Betreuung und schnelle Reaktionszeiten. Das Unternehmen verfügt so über ein eigenes Vertriebsnetz aus Außendienstmitarbeitenden und Produktmanagern.
records.population: Gühring's sales organisation
records.does_not_establish: It does not say how much is sold through distributors or retailers versus direct, nor whether this network could serve private buyers.

records.source_title: Gühring Nachhaltigkeitsbericht 2024 (CSR-Bericht)
records.excerpt: Auch nimmt der globale Wettbewerb im Bereich Präzisionswerkzeuge zu, insbesondere durch Anbieter aus Asien. Preis- und Margendruck können die Rentabilität beeinträchtigen, wenn keine kontinuierlichen Produktinnovationen und Effizienzsteigerungen erfolgen.
records.population: Precision tool makers competing with Gühring
records.does_not_establish: It is a risk statement about the industrial business and does not quantify margins or say anything about consumer segments.

records.source_title: Gühring Nachhaltigkeitsbericht 2024 (CSR-Bericht)
records.excerpt: Der Trend zur Substitution des HSS-Werkzeuges durch das Hartmetallwerkzeug hielt auch in 2024 an und wir erwarten, dass sich dies auch in Zukunft fortsetzt. Dennoch ist die Gühring-Gruppe aufgrund der Fertigungstechnologie (Komplettbearbeitung von Werkzeugen) in der Lage, den Marktanteil bei HSS-Werkzeugen zu halten.
records.population: Gühring group, HSS and carbide tool business
records.does_not_establish: It gives no figures for HSS volumes or market share, and does not say whether freed HSS capacity could go to DIY or hobby products.

records.source_title: Digital B2B online shop & OCI punchout – Gühring
records.excerpt: With a PunchOut interface, the Gühring online shop and your ERP system merge: you place the desired products in the shopping basket in our shop and transfer the relevant product data to your procurement system to generate a order.
records.population: Registered business buyers of the Gühring online shop
records.does_not_establish: It describes procurement features for companies and does not state whether private individuals can register or buy cutting tools in this shop.

records.source_title: Dianoz Onlineshop (Gühring)
records.excerpt: Für leidenschaftliche Maker: DIANOZ Diamant Spitze Grundkörper aus Stahl Spezielle Bügelfläche zum Glätten beim Druck Für alle Filamente & Granulate geeignet bis 300°C Alle Ausführungen für 99 €
records.geography: Germany, shipping not stated in passage
records.population: Hobby 3D-printing makers addressed by Gühring's DIANOZ nozzle shop
records.does_not_establish: It shows a maker-targeted offer and price, but not how many consumers buy it or whether it is profitable.

records.source_title: Additive Fertigung – Diamantdüse DIANOZ (Gühring)
records.excerpt: Verschleiß und schlechte Wärmeleitfähigkeit beeinträchtigen den Druckprozess und das Druckergebnis. Deshalb hat Gühring in mehr als zwei Jahren Forschungs- und Entwicklungsarbeit eine neuartige Nozzle entwickelt: die diamantbestückte Druckerdüse DIANOZ.
records.population: Gühring's additive manufacturing product line
records.does_not_establish: It describes the product's origin in Gühring's diamond-tool know-how but gives no development cost or sales results.

records.source_title: Gühring | Internal restructuring | Factsheet 300333 (Eurofound European Restructuring Monitor)
records.excerpt: Gühring, a German precision machining specialist, announced 300 job cuts in the Zollernalb region, affecting the cities of Albstadt and Sigmaringen‑Laiz. The layoffs will impact around 10 to 15 per cent of the company's workforce in the region. The firm's management explained that the decision was due to difficult economic conditions and increasing competitive pressure.
records.population: Gühring employees at Albstadt and Sigmaringen-Laiz
records.does_not_establish: It shows pressure on the core business but not whether management would fund or reject a consumer diversification in response.

records.source_title: Guhring tooling reputation (Model Engineer & Workshop forum)
records.excerpt: My usual brand for drill bits is dormer but recently got a Guhring 14mm twist drill. Anyone here got an opinion either way on the quality of them? Couldn't find much on the internet except their website so I suppose they usually sell direct to industry.
records.population: A hobby model engineer buying a single Gühring drill
records.does_not_establish: One 2016 forum post shows low awareness in one hobbyist, not the size or habits of the hobby machining market.

records.source_title: Guhring tooling reputation (Model Engineer & Workshop forum)
records.excerpt: Have a number of Guhring small drills myself; the quality is top notch, no wobble, straight as a die, sizes drilled within .001" not oversized, the only trouble is their price but if I can 'obtain', 'be given' any tooling by them I will grab it.
records.population: A hobby model engineer who owns Gühring drills
records.does_not_establish: One forum member's view of quality and price does not measure willingness to pay among hobbyists generally.

records.source_title: Kunden kaufen weniger Werkzeug und Gartengeräte im Baumarkt (Nordkurier, dpa)
records.excerpt: Die Baumärkte haben ein Problem: Die Menschen in Deutschland kaufen zwar weiter Werkzeug, Gartengeräte und Haushaltswaren – nur immer seltener bei ihnen. In den drei wichtigen Teilsortimenten gingen die Umsätze 2025 im Vergleich zum Vorjahr um jeweils etwa vier Prozent zurück, wie eine Auswertung des Handelsverbands Heimwerken, Bauen und Garten (BHB) zeigt.
records.population: German DIY store chains and their tool sales
records.does_not_establish: It covers DIY store sales of tools in general and says nothing about premium metal-cutting tools or online specialist channels.

records.source_title: Metallbohrer-Test: Vergleich und Kaufberatung (Heimwerker.de)
records.excerpt: In diversen Internet-Foren sind Hobby-Heimwerker jedoch geteilter Meinung was die Qualität des Marken-Zubehörs betrifft. Ebenso ist es auch bei den Metallbohrern. Sehr beliebt sind hingegen Bohrer von Proxxon, Alpen und S&R
records.population: Hobby DIY users discussing metal drill bits online
records.does_not_establish: It is a magazine's summary of forum opinion, not a survey, and its silence on Gühring does not prove DIY buyers do not know the brand.

records.source_title: Bosch Heimwerken & Garten HSS-TiN-Metallbohrer-Satz, 19-teilig grün (ALTERNATE)
records.excerpt: Die 19 Spiralbohrer aus Hochleistungsschnellstahl mit Titan-Nitrid-Beschichtung sind für präzise Bohrungen in Eisen, Stahl, Nichteisenmetallen, Grauguss und Hartkunststoffen geeignet. Der Schaft des Bohrers ist zylindrisch (der Schaftdurchmesser entspricht dem Bohrerdurchmesser). Die Bohrer sind mit Bohrständern und Bohrschraubern aller Elektrowerkzeugmarken kompatibel.
records.population: Buyers of Bosch's DIY-line accessories at a consumer electronics and tool retailer
records.does_not_establish: It shows a competitor's DIY metal-drill set at retail but not its sales volume, margin, or whether a premium industrial brand could win there.

records.source_title: ALPEN-MAYKESTAG GmbH – Company
records.excerpt: ALPEN Precision drill bits for every job and every demand. Drills for all materials. Concrete and masonry drill bits Drills for metal Drills for wood Special drill bits MAYKESTAG High-performance tools for the metalworking industry. Single-source supplier of solid carbide and HSS tools.
records.population: Alpen-Maykestag's two brands, a general drill brand and an industrial one
records.does_not_establish: It shows a two-brand structure at a smaller competitor but not which channels or buyers each brand reaches or how each performs.

records.source_title: Heller Premium Tools – quality and innovation (Fastener + Fixing Magazine)
records.excerpt: In the future, Heller will be focusing on its strength as a provider of professional tools and the best services for customers and professional users. This will be visible to the outside world firstly through the newly designed company logo with the brand claim: ‘Premium Tools’, which describes Heller’s self-image.
records.population: Heller Tools, a German drill-bit maker
records.does_not_establish: It shows one drill maker choosing a professional focus in 2019, not why, nor whether its consumer business was unprofitable.

records.source_title: Is the Tormach 1100M the best for a home CNC mill? (Tormach)
records.excerpt: Most of our customers are hobbyists working from home or small workshops tight on space but in need of a reliable, affordable CNC mill. What Projects Do They Do? The average home Tormach 1100M CNC mill owner usually makes light-to-medium cuts three-to-five times a week with a variety of project materials ranging from softwoods right through to titanium.
records.population: Tormach's home and small-workshop CNC mill owners
records.does_not_establish: It is a machine vendor's description of its own customers and does not size the home CNC market or its spending on cutting tools.

records.source_title: Industrial shipments rebound as entry-level surge continues (Formnext, Mesago)
records.excerpt: Shipments surged 47% in Q4 2025 and rose 26% for the full year, with Chinese vendors accounting for over 90% of global volume. Bambu Lab held a 37% market share in the period, with Creality, Elegoo and Anycubic also among the leaders.
records.population: Entry-level (sub-$2,500) 3D printer market, per CONTEXT data
records.does_not_establish: Printer shipments do not show how many owners buy premium replacement nozzles or what they would pay.

records.source_title: VDMA Präzisionswerkzeuge: 2025 zwischen Krisenlast und Stabilisierung (Produktion)
records.excerpt: Die Präzisionswerkzeugindustrie verzeichnete im vergangenen Jahr ein Produktionsminus von rund 7 Prozent auf etwa 8,5 Milliarden Euro. Viele Unternehmen mussten Personal abbauen und Investitionen zurückfahren. Der Inlandsmarkt blieb schwach, insbesondere aufgrund rückläufiger Produktion im Maschinenbau und anhaltender Unsicherheit in der Automobilindustrie.
records.population: German precision tool industry
records.does_not_establish: It covers the whole German industry, not Gühring's own results, and says nothing about consumer demand.

records.source_title: Dianoz 3D printing nozzles designed for ultra-durability (Filament2Print)
records.excerpt: Diamond nozzle DIANOZ 3D Ultra-resistant nozzle with a diamond tip. Compatible with many systems, materials and printers.
records.population: Customers of a 3D-printing supplies retailer serving individuals and professionals
records.does_not_establish: A single listing shows third-party retail availability, not sales volume or the share of buyers who are private individuals.
